answer: Farming becomes an echo bet on surviving 83 epochs of grading, and every walnut settlement recomputes the vault schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 83 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 25 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
